entries.text: Before servicing a mechanical typewriter spread a clean white cloth beneath the machine so that small springs and typebars cannot roll away, and keep the dust cover closed until every ribbon spool has been labelled. Note the order of anything you remove.

Whenever a typebar assembly sticks, elevate it gently with a hooked extraction wire rather than pulling it upward, because the segment slots deform easily and a distorted slot misaligns every adjacent key sharing that arc. Work under a bright lamp.

After taking an object, verify it is actually in your inventory (e.g., via inventory) before attempting to place or use it; if the take action fails silently, retry taking the object from its location, and if a subsequent put/move fails, check whether your hands are full by attempting to take another object.

If a "put" action repeatedly fails despite being at the correct location and holding the object, try the alternative phrasing "move <object> to <receptacle>"; if that also fails, try a different valid receptacle of the same type, and if the receptacle is a container, ensure it is open first.
